items.q: But he loved Chin Chow. You remember in the paper they had this little Chinaman... Chin Chow says this, and all of these sayings like Confusius, you know. Prez lived by this...

ctx.x: Do you remember anything like that, examples?

No, I can't just cite, you know, anything in particular. But he loved Chin Chow. You remember in the paper they had this little Chinaman, I think it's a Chinaman, Chin Chow says this, and all of these sayings like Confusius, you know. Prez lived by this, every day he would cut this out and it was just some profound sayings. But he had an earthy way about him that was -- Lester -- no one else, there was no one like Lester, no one could express himself like Lester.
